rationale.why_implementation_defect: The PX0-06 implementation moved unconditional Web product-toolbar/create/destroy code onto WebRuntimeFacade while leaving that facade and its runtime maps inside AXIOM_WEB_DEBUG_UI. The defect is therefore in the implementation placement/lifetime of the already-authorized Web RuntimeFacade path.
rationale.why_not_authority_defect: Authority already requires temporary toolbar mutation to converge on RuntimeFacade while platform Debug UI remains an optional/debug concern.
rationale.why_not_task_package_defect: The original package adequately authorized bridge.cpp host convergence and explicitly required the RuntimeFacade lifecycle to be independent of Debug UI visibility. The missing debug-off build oracle contributed to detection latency but does not make the implementation bug structurally unrepairable under the authorized file.
rationale.why_not_environment_defect: The failure follows deterministically from C++ preprocessing and the repository's explicit AXIOM_WEB_DEBUG_UI=0 configuration path.

repair_boundary.required_intent: Move the Web RuntimeFacade product adapter and per-host facade lifetime outside the AXIOM_WEB_DEBUG_UI conditional, while keeping DebugController/ImGui/Web Debug UI presentation code conditional. Preserve the same RuntimeFacade instance for toolbar and DebugController when Debug UI is enabled.
repair_boundary.production_semantics_change: No new product semantics; repair availability/compile ownership only.
forbidden: CMake option/policy changes solely to force Debug UI on

required: Compile axiom_ink_playground_web with AXIOM_BUILD_DEBUG_UI=OFF / AXIOM_WEB_DEBUG_UI=0 using an appropriate existing Web profile or equivalent clean configuration.
Rerun relevant PX0/DUI focused regressions and scope/diff checks.
reverification.note: The debug-off compile is the unique oracle for the newly discovered compatibility failure mode.
